description: List observatories whose telescope share is above the average share, ordered by how far above average they are. Return the top 10 plus every observatory tied with the 10th on that difference.

b.request: List observatories whose share of all telescopes is above the average share across observatories, ordered by descending difference between their share and the average; return the top 10 plus all observatories tied with the 10th on that difference, showing observatory station, telescope count, share, and unrounded difference
b.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC) AS rn
  FROM observatory_counts
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
FROM scored
WHERE rn <= 10
   OR difference >= (SELECT difference FROM scored WHERE rn = 10)
ORDER BY difference DESC

a.request: For each observatory station, count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Among observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, list the `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and how far the share is above the average (share minus average share), with no rounding. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return the top 10, also including every observatory that ties with the 10th one on that difference, even if that means more than 10 rows.
a.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM station_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM shares
), eligible AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
  FROM ranked
  WHERE difference > 0
), cutoff AS (
  SELECT difference
  FROM eligible
  ORDER BY difference DESC
  OFFSET 9 LIMIT 1
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
FROM eligible
WHERE difference >= (SELECT difference FROM cutoff)
ORDER BY difference DESC;

c.request: For each observatory station, count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Which are the top 10 observatories whose share is above the average share across observatories, ranked by how far above average they are? Show the `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and the share minus the average share, unrounded, from the biggest gap to the smallest. List observatories whose telescope share is above the average share, ordered by how far above average they are. Return the top 10 plus every observatory tied with the 10th on that difference.
c.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM station_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE above_average > 0
  AND share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_average DESC;

d.request: For each observatory station, count its telescopes and calculate its share of all telescopes. List the top 10 observatories whose share is above the average share across observatories, ranked by the difference between their share and the average share, largest first. Include every observatory tied with the 10th on that difference. Return the observatory station, telescope count, share, and difference, unrounded.
d.sql:
WITH station_shares AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM station_shares
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    difference,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS position
  FROM scored
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM station_shares)
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= 10
ORDER BY difference DESC, observstation;
